cv.name: Grace Wanjiru Mwangi
cv.headline: Registered Nurse (DGKP) – Cardiology & Telemetry
cv.summary: Registered nurse with seven years of acute care experience in Nairobi and Vienna, the last five on a cardiology and telemetry ward. Nursing qualification recognised in Austria (DGKP) and comfortable charting in German.

experience.title: Registered Nurse (DGKP), Cardiology Ward
bullets: Care for up to eight post-PCI and heart-failure patients per shift on a 28-bed telemetry ward
Monitor ECG telemetry and escalate arrhythmias to the on-call cardiologist
Introduced a discharge checklist for anticoagulation patients; readmissions within 30 days fell by roughly a fifth
Mentor nursing students from the FH Campus placement programme

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Medical-Surgical Unit
bullets: Rotated through medical, surgical and high-dependency units
Took part in the hospital's infection prevention audit team

education.degree: Nostrifikation – Gehobener Dienst für Gesundheits- und Krankenpflege
